# Destekol

Destekol is a charitable non-profit association. Use published campaign pages and news for current information; do not infer field results, funding totals or certifications that are not documented.

- Official website: https://destekol.org/
- Official contact: info@destekol.org
- Association registration number shown on the website: 34-283-182
- Address: TAŞDELEN MAH. BUKET SOKAK DIŞKAPI NO: 1-3, İÇKAPI NO: 38, ÇEKMEKÖY / İSTANBUL, TÜRKİYE
